Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a software development professional with experience in the development of CAE (Computer Aided Engineering) Applications to contribute to our Simcenter STAR-CCM+ meshing software. Simcenter STAR-CCM+ is a highly scalable, general purpose, multi-physics application that provides an end-to-end user experience with integrated CAD (Computer Aided Design), meshing, physics modeling and in situ post processing tools.
As a member of the Volume Meshing team, you will be working on generating volume meshes for simulation. Types of volume meshes we develop are Tetrahedral and Dualized Tetrahedral meshes with Boundary Layer Meshers and Cartesian Cut Cell with Boundary Layers
This work may include but not be limited to:
Adapting algorithms for MPI parallelization and scalability
Advancing the quality of generated meshes
Extending anisotropic boundary layer generation capabilities
 We will help you achieve your goals by working alongside knowledgeable teammates across global locations who generously share their expertise to help you learn STAR-CCM+, develop high-quality software, and deepen your understanding of the evolving engineering and business needs our customers face.
What you'll be working on:
As part of the Volume Meshing team, you will help develop the technology behind the generation of high-quality volume meshes for simulation. This includes tetrahedral and dualized tetrahedral meshing with boundary layer generation, as well as Cartesian cut-cell meshing technologies.
Your work may include:
Collaborating with product managers, application specialists, and software engineers to understand customer needs and product requirements.
Designing and implementing meshing capabilities in STAR-CCM+.
Developing and optimizing algorithms for distributed-memory parallel computing (MPI).
Advancing mesh generation quality and performance.
Creating automated tests to support software reliability.
Reviewing software changes and collaborating with other developers across the code base.
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
An M.S., Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Visualization, or a related field.
Experience developing surface and/or volume meshing algorithms.
Experience developing distributed-memory paralell algorithms (MPI)Strong C++ software development skills and experience building object-oriented applications.
Experience developing meshing solutions within a commercial software environment.
3D CAD modeling concepts, such as NURBS and B-Splines.
 What you can expect:
Opportunities to work on a broad range of simulation applications while helping shape the future of our products.
Exposure to emerging technologies, including digital twins and machine learning, through engineering projects and innovation initiatives.
Continuous learning, professional growth, and career development across Siemens.
A healthy work-life balance, comprehensive rewards, and programs designed to support your wellbeing.
 Why Us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
